pages.text: Before a long journey, a medicine cat gives traveling herbs. $(br2)$(li)$(l)Sorrel$() eases hunger and thirst.$(li)$(l)Burnet$() gives strength.$(li)$(l)Chamomile$() calms the heart.$(li)$(l)Daisy$() soothes aching joints.
pages.title: For the Journey

pages.text: Bundle all four in dock leaves on an Herb Rock. If you walk to the old forest, take some with you!
pages.title: Traveling Herbs
